issue_request: FHIR-3350 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification security work-group change request asking that the security-labels page change the old "Keep information from patient" tag from deprecated ActCode#TABOO to ActCode#TBOO.

A later 2014 documentation consistency commit preserved the corrected TBOO spelling while converting the row into an ActCode link.
additional_context: The current security-labels page is active and referenced from source/hierarchy.xml and source/documentation.html, but later security-label revisions reorganized the old standalone core-code table into HCS/value-set guidance. Current source has no TABOO occurrences under source, and TBOO remains active in the checked-in v3 terminology source and in a current Condition example.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk was needed because the erroneous TABOO spelling is absent and adding a local TBOO row would be redundant with the current HCS/value-set guidance.
